description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the World Tree believe that their Rage links them to the cosmic ash tree Yggdrasil. This 'world tree' grows among the Outer Planes, connecting them to each other and to the many worlds of the Material Plane. These Barbarians draw on their connection to the world tree as a source of vitality and as a means of travel across the multiverse.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Your Rage taps into the lifeforce of the World Tree. Vitality Surge: When you activate your Rage, gain temporary hit points equal to your Barbarian level. Life-Giving Force: At start of each turn while raging, choose another creature within 10 feet to gain temporary HP (roll d6s equal to Rage Damage bonus). These temp HP vanish when Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While your Rage is active, whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to summon spectral branches. Target must succeed on Strength saving throw (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier) or be teleported to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of yourself. You can then reduce its Speed to 0 until end of current turn.

features.name: Battering Boots
features.description: Tendrils of the World Tree extend from your melee weapons. While you wield a Heavy or Versatile melee weapon, your reach with that weapon increases by 10 feet. When you hit with this weapon, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to any other Mastery property.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.description: You can briefly travel along the World Tree. When you activate your Rage and as a Bonus Action while it's active, teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Additionally, when you teleport, you can bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet of yourself (range increases to 500 feet). Each teleports to unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of destination. Can teleport other creatures only once per Rage.
